module.title: Torso · fit closed rings and join the legs
checks: If the hip-yaw joints are already fastened, steps 1–10 temporarily remove and reuse seven screws on each completed side. Apply removal only to a side already fastened; keep its lower joints and feet assembled.

For a fresh build with loose yaw motors and links, begin at step 11; do not first fasten and undo the yaw joint. Fit the plate and closed rings before closing that joint, and keep the four-joint leg units separate. This validates the shown joining stations, not a complete fresh-build workflow.
Keep power_support off until both yaw-side case/rear attachments are fastened.
This is sampled rigid geometry and tool access, not physical-fit or strength certification.

operations.title: Left: release only the yaw-side attachment
operations.text: Keep the foot, ankle, knee, hip-pitch and hip-roll output joints assembled. Remove only S09-case-079, S09-case-080, S09-rear_center-109: two M2×8 yaw-link case screws and one M2.6×6 rear-center screw. Keep the two bearing-roll case screws installed. Support the complete four-joint leg; do not loosen its other screws.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: collect the loose rear washer
operations.text: Remove washer9 toward the rear screw side (−X). Keep the existing 0.5 mm washer with its rear-center screw. It must come out before the leg unit moves in the opposite direction.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: withdraw the complete four-joint leg
operations.text: Pull the complete retained leg unit in +X and place it on a separate bench. Its passive bearing part stays attached by its two existing case screws. The yaw link and upper yaw motor stay together for now.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: release the now-exposed yaw output
operations.text: With the four-joint leg on the other bench, remove the four M2×6 output screws of ID10. They were blocked by ID9 before withdrawal.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: lift out the bare yaw motor
operations.text: Lift ID10 from the loose yaw link. Keep all seven removed screws and the washer for reassembly; no other leg joint needs to be opened.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: release only the yaw-side attachment
operations.text: Keep the foot, ankle, knee, hip-pitch and hip-roll output joints assembled. Remove only S04-case-101, S04-case-102, S04-rear_center-113: two M2×8 yaw-link case screws and one M2.6×6 rear-center screw. Keep the two bearing-roll case screws installed. Support the complete four-joint leg; do not loosen its other screws.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: collect the loose rear washer
operations.text: Remove washer4 toward the rear screw side (−X). Keep the existing 0.5 mm washer with its rear-center screw. It must come out before the leg unit moves in the opposite direction.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: withdraw the complete four-joint leg
operations.text: Pull the complete retained leg unit in +X and place it on a separate bench. Its passive bearing part stays attached by its two existing case screws. The yaw link and upper yaw motor stay together for now.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: release the now-exposed yaw output
operations.text: With the four-joint leg on the other bench, remove the four M2×6 output screws of ID5. They were blocked by ID4 before withdrawal.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: lift out the bare yaw motor
operations.text: Lift ID5 from the loose yaw link. Keep all seven removed screws and the washer for reassembly; no other leg joint needs to be opened.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Prepare the bare torso plate
operations.text: Keep the power support off. Support the plate and each loose ring by hand until the matching yaw link captures it. The completed four-joint legs stay on their separate benches.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Place left closed torso ring
operations.text: Place the closed Ø22 ring from beneath the plate, before closing its yaw joint. Hold it square against its seat; it is still loose.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Place right closed torso ring
operations.text: Place the closed Ø22 ring from beneath the plate, before closing its yaw joint. Hold it square against its seat; it is still loose.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Lower bare ID10 into the plate
operations.text: Lower the bare motor from above while supporting the loose ring underneath. Neither yaw link nor complete leg is being forced through a closed ring.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Lower bare ID5 into the plate
operations.text: Lower the bare motor from above while supporting the loose ring underneath. Neither yaw link nor complete leg is being forced through a closed ring.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Stabilize the two motors at the plate-only screws
operations.text: Install S10-case-070 and S05-case-073, both M2×8. Keep the shared power-support holes unused until the support is installed; continue to support the core on the bench.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: refit the yaw link below its closed ring
operations.text: Bring the yaw link from below, with the previously fitted ring already in place. This closes the captured-ring joint while the roll motor is still on the separate bench.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: refasten the exposed yaw output
operations.text: Reinstall the same four M2×6 output screws now, before the four-joint leg blocks their screw and driver paths.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: bring back the intact four-joint leg
operations.text: Bring the supported unit from +X. Its ankle, foot, knee and hip output joints remain assembled. Keep the power support absent so the two yaw-side case screws and rear center are reachable.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: replace the rear washer
operations.text: Place the original 0.5 mm washer from −X at its rear-center seat. Use the same washer and screw; no new hardware is added.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Left: refasten the yaw-side attachment
operations.text: Reinstall the same two M2×8 yaw-link case screws and M2.6×6 rear-center screw. The two bearing-roll case screws and all lower joint fasteners have remained installed.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: refit the yaw link below its closed ring
operations.text: Bring the yaw link from below, with the previously fitted ring already in place. This closes the captured-ring joint while the roll motor is still on the separate bench.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: refasten the exposed yaw output
operations.text: Reinstall the same four M2×6 output screws now, before the four-joint leg blocks their screw and driver paths.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: bring back the intact four-joint leg
operations.text: Bring the supported unit from +X. Its ankle, foot, knee and hip output joints remain assembled. Keep the power support absent so the two yaw-side case screws and rear center are reachable.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: replace the rear washer
operations.text: Place the original 0.5 mm washer from −X at its rear-center seat. Use the same washer and screw; no new hardware is added.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Right: refasten the yaw-side attachment
operations.text: Reinstall the same two M2×8 yaw-link case screws and M2.6×6 rear-center screw. The two bearing-roll case screws and all lower joint fasteners have remained installed.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Fit the power support after both leg attachments are closed
operations.text: Now bring the power support from −X. Installing it earlier blocks a yaw-side case screw and rear-center driver on each leg; finish those before this step.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.

operations.title: Finish the four remaining torso case screws
operations.text: Install these four M2×10 screws. The two M2×8 plate-only screws are already installed. Keep the orange torso shells off until the neck is positioned and its rear-center screws are complete.
operations.evidenceScope: Only source geometry and declared hardware/tool envelopes; physical fit and printed stiffness not certified.
